subject: Story selector: one implementation from Claude writer handoff
body:
Ziggy explicitly clarified: need the writer to inform CFA Site Index Nova how to update our storyboard page. Desired page: a PRIMARY STORY SELECTOR, MetaMirror by default, other stories/episodes selectable, each showing its visual panel sequence. Distinguish prose-only plans from panels with linked images. Stage may be secondary. Preserve existing stage, review, reference, selections and accepted timing data. Coordinate one implementation; no competing edits. This is the narrow subsequent user direction, not a retry of the cancelled broader handoff.

Claude is being asked in the same conversation to supply story structure, story/panel order and proposed image mappings. You retain site code/data/build/publication ownership and should coordinate one page implementation from that writer handoff at a compatible checkpoint. Lead with story selection (MetaMirror default), then the chosen story/episode visual panel sequence; mark prose-only plans separately. Preserve existing stage/review/reference data. Reuse established canonical sources and renderer/build paths, and retain exact image associations and unknowns. This helper makes no code changes. No duplicate task/new worker or broad parallel edits are requested.

source.instruction: Latest explicit user clarification relayed in this task; narrow writer-to-site storyboard handoff only.
